## Summary

Describe the motivation and the user-visible or schema-visible change.

## Downstream impact

- [ ] OWL
- [ ] SHACL
- [ ] JSON Schema
- [ ] Generated documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `make validate` passes
- [ ] `make gen` has regenerated `output/` and `docs/`
- [ ] Generated artifacts are committed
- [ ] New or changed classes, slots, enums, and enum values have English descriptions
- [ ] Validation cases cover new or changed constraints
- [ ] The change is backward compatible, or `BREAKING CHANGE:` is documented
- [ ] Public documentation and examples have been updated
